male.down:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: a production unlayered animated protagonist sprite sheet for a cozy top-down pixel RPG.
Image 1 is the existing HERO: preserve their face, short tousled chestnut hair, peach skin, teal tunic with ivory trim, brown leather belt, dark trousers, brown boots, chibi proportions. Images 2 and 3 are NPC STYLE references ONLY. Draw just this one same hero, like an animation artist drawing successive frames from the same model sheet.
GENUINELY TRANSPARENT PNG. EXACTLY 4 columns and 3 rows of equal cells, 12 complete figures total, no other art. Image target 1024 x 1152 pixels, cell 256 x 384. No border, no grid lines, no text, no ground shadows. Each full character occupies about 82% of cell height, with fixed body center and the same planted-foot baseline, safely clear of each cell edge. Fixed camera slightly elevated orthographic RPG view. Clean pixel art, crisp deep warm brown outline, teal and cream clothing, warm brown hair and boots. No colored matte, absolutely no red edge artifacts or red patches, no glows or effects. Consistent same face, head size, hair, outfit and proportions across all 12 frames. No hats, capes, weapons, spell effects, extra accessories.
IMPORTANT: This is an ACTUAL ANIMATION. Legs must change shape and boots must travel through different positions. DO NOT repeat a static figure with tiny changes. A plausible gentle WALK, not marching, skating, running or hovering. One complete cohesive figure per frame, never separate parts.
Layout, read left to right then next row:
TOP ROW = walk frames 1,2,3,4.
MIDDLE ROW = walk frames 5,6,7,8.
BOTTOM ROW = idle frames 1,2,3,4, BOTH FEET PARALLEL ON THE GROUND, ARMS RELAXED, same character's breathing loop.
Walk frame 1: LEFT LEG extends forward and right leg trails back, RIGHT ARM forward and left arm back, clearly split boots.
Walk frame 2: weight settles over the left foot, right heel lifts, knees flex slightly.
Walk frame 3: right boot lifted and passing directly under the hips, left supporting leg straight.
Walk frame 4: RIGHT BOOT SWINGS FORWARD in the air, left heel beginning to lift, left arm advancing.
Walk frame 5: RIGHT LEG extends forward and left leg trails back, LEFT ARM forward and right arm back. This must be the OPPOSITE stride silhouette to frame 1.
Walk frame 6: weight settles over the right foot, left heel lifts, knees flex slightly.
Walk frame 7: left boot lifted and passing under the hips, right supporting leg straight.
Walk frame 8: LEFT BOOT SWINGS FORWARD in the air, right heel beginning to lift, right arm advancing. Seamlessly loops to frame 1.
Idle 1: neutral stance. Idle 2: small breath in. Idle 3: gently held breath with a single natural blink. Idle 4: breath settles back into idle 1. Restrained 1-2 pixel breathing, no large body scaling or foot motion.
All figures walk in place around their cell center, no across-the-sheet drift. Match ground baseline and consistent head/torso scale. Pixel clusters suitable for uniform whole-sheet reduction to 64x96 pixels per cell.
DIRECTION FOR EVERY SINGLE FRAME IN THIS SHEET: FRONT VIEW FACING DOWN toward the camera. Both eyes visible, symmetrical face. Walking toward the viewer, feet foreshorten forward and backward.
